purpose: Secondary, independent simulator cross-checks ONLY. No simulator output is a measured wartime airframe result or interchangeable aircraft variant.

il2.source: IL-2 Sturmovik Great Battles developer aircraft specifications
il2.status: developer-published flight-model statistics; game-version and difficulty/atmosphere details may have changed

dcs.source: Eagle Dynamics official DCS documentation and independent DCS simulator test reports
dcs.note: Official manuals identify simulated variants and operations; manual historical diagrams are NOT DCS-measured flight-model outputs

aircraft.engine: R-2800-59, 2600 hp water-injection WEP (64 inHg, 2700 rpm)
aircraft.comparison: DO NOT compute P-47B historical/model residuals against D-28: different engine, prop and ~14,337 vs 12,565 lb test weight. Greg D-style 2600 hp worksheet is NOT a matched D-28 test.

aircraft.engine: Packard V-1650-7 (explicitly select -7 option; game also offers V-1650-3)
aircraft.comparison: Same engine designation as historical P-51B-15, but DIFFERENT B block, ~9,676 versus 9,240 lb, fuel/load and engine horsepower representations (IL-2 specifies 1650 hp sea level versus 1580 hp at 0 ft in historical node model); do not fit B-15 to this benchmark.
D-15 is NOT B-15: different canopy and airframe drag, mass, fuel and equipment.

aircraft.simulator: DCS World, 2022 user-measured, derivative E-M chart
aircraft.flightCondition: Full power, clean, 0 ft; Tacview observations reprocessed via derived aerodynamic fit; IAS calibration not given
aircraft.comparison: User-derived and author LOW confidence, historical DCS version and unknown exact engine setting; never promote to DCS official or to P-51B measured flight data.

aircraft.simulator: DCS World, old v2.5.6.57530, 2020 user measurement
aircraft.comparison: DCS player P-51D at 67 inHg and IL-2 developer P-51D-15 at WEP both state 592 km/h TAS sea level: notable convergence but distinct variant, temperature, fuel and historical simulator builds. Never treat matching reported numbers as proof of independent fidelity.

aircraft.simulator: DCS World, old v2.5.6.57530, 2020 user measurement
aircraft.comparison: DO NOT compare 71-inHg DCS D-30 615 km/h sea-level directly with 64-inHg IL-2 D-28 557 km/h; both rating AND model differ. DCS official P-47D manual confirms D-30 (not P-47B).
